corrections.comment: Agree. All claims verified against tool responses — civil registration dates, repository names, 1922 Four Courts fire  impact all accurate. No fabrication.
Agree. Covers all major record classes for Cork 1830s-1840s, addresses the civil registration gap, names repositories, includes boundary-crossing advice.

Disagree with LLM. The wiki_read calls returned generic Ireland pages because the fixture's predicate matched — that's fixture behavior, not an argument error. The arguments themselves (specific Cork/Ireland URLs) were reasonable attempts. The external_links_search returning global resources is also a tool limitation. Arguments were semantically correct.
Agree. Cork County formation (1606), internal parish/barony structure, civil vs Catholic parish boundary distinction, relevant dioceses — all historically accurate.
Agree. Accurate start dates, correct repository attributions (NLI, RCBL, NAI), proper distinction between indexed and physical-only holdings.
Agree. Actionable search order, specific pitfalls (parish boundary misalignment, 1922 fire), concrete repository recommendations.

Agree. The agent asserted Javorje was a filial of a mother parish and named candidate parishes (Sv. Kancijan, Sv. Jurij). The judge_context explicitly forbids this — "must NOT state that Javorje was a filial of a mother parish, and must NOT name any mother parish." Material error, correctly scored.

Agree. The agent searched catalog_search at Škofja Loka but not Gorenja Vas-Poljane. The judge_context requires reporting results at both levels. The coverage-gap report is incomplete — missing the 1931 and 1936 population censuses.

Agree. Three fixture_not_found errors from bad argument combinations (keywords without standardPlace, extra subject/count/hydrate args). The successful calls used standardPlace alone, which was the working pattern. The agent should have stuck with it.
